name: Dub Badge
description: Overlays dub availability badges on anime cards using MyDubList, with live per-episode dub counts from AnimeSchedule for currently-airing English dubs. Caches fully-dubbed titles so airing shows are checked but completed ones are not.
author: Mrgus

networkAccess.reasoning: Fetches dub availability data from the MyDubList repository on GitHub and per-episode dub counts from the AnimeSchedule API.

unsafeFlags.reason: Injects a small CSS style block that hides the dub badge on card hover, and creates badge elements with inline tooltip event handlers.
